title: 第一卷 第21章 符盟来寻第一卷 第22章 挖洞
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 太玄仙宗，清寒峰。
随着庞大的灵气逐渐回落，不时有修士从各峰御剑而来。
“终于成功了！清寒突破结丹期，我太玄仙宗再添一金丹长老！”
“哈哈哈！此乃大幸事！百年内成就金丹，放在整个南荒域也是耀眼的存在。”
“虽然清寒自身契合《太玄经》功法，但也和她的努力脱不开干系！”
数日后，柳清寒送走最后一位祝贺的长老，招来徒弟琉璃。
“徒儿，林寻现在是否到了宗门的后方？”柳清寒开口道。
琉璃乖巧的点头，“是，师尊，林师伯的一切已安排妥当。”
“嗯！”柳清寒微微颔首，继续问道，“二阶延寿丹，可给了？”
琉璃扫了眼储物戒指，一颗晶莹剔透的丹药放置在玉匣中，正是二阶延寿丹，旁边有块暗金色的木牌，上面刻着清寒二字。
“已按师尊的吩咐给了！”
“那你退下吧，为师需巩固一二。”
“是！”琉璃弯身倒退几步，而后快速离去。
柳清寒注视前方良久，自言自语道。
“快了，还有五年天澜秘境就开了！”
三日后，林寻已经摸清了这里的大致情况。
青云山坊市隶属李氏仙族，地盘很大，不仅有坊市，还有特产的一阶灵材——青云竹。
青云竹通体青碧，坚韧轻便，可用来做竹剑和竹盾。
林寻能用到的是竹子内膜鞣制成的符纸，能绘制下品符箓。
所以整个青云山坊市，下品符师的数量是最多的。
而四周的邻居，有户散修夫妻，炼气初期，早出晚归在坊市做工。
有户是养竹子的灵农。
也有几户数日不见人影，为外出猎妖寻草的炼气中期散修。
总的来说，居不易！
这里光租金每月都要五块下品灵石。
林寻手中的灵石几乎见底，大头却花在了手中阵盘上。
“还多亏了苏店主，二十块下品灵石就拿下此阵。”
言罢，他抬手对阵盘输入灵力，须臾间一道金光护罩出现，而后缓慢扩大，直到笼罩住整个屋子才停下。
他兀自感受一番，五丈方圆内都在阵法笼罩之下。
“此阵法有隔音，隔灵，预警的功效，虽无攻击之能，却是我最需要的！终于可以吸收灵乳了！”
林寻感觉颇为心酸。
没有阵法前，他连与杨芸的双修都不香了。
只因结出的灵乳，只能干看着，根本不敢炼化。
毕竟这里是棚户区，鱼龙混杂。
万一吸收的灵气波动，被人发现异常，那他真是离死不远了。
林寻又取出几张火球符，贴在窗户上，才打坐内视。
识海中一株宝树在轻轻摇曳，枝头上挂着数滴灵乳。
最引人注目的是这根枝丫的颜色，居然泛起淡淡的紫意。
“自从上次芸儿父兄获救后，枝丫就有了新的变化，成了淡紫色，也不知道这灵乳效果是不是有所提升？”
林寻张望半天，好奇的开口道。

Taixuan Immortal Sect, Qinghan Peak.
As the huge spiritual energy gradually receded, monks came from time to time to wield swords from various peaks.
"Finally successful! Qinghan has broken through the elixir formation stage, and our Taixuan Immortal Sect has added another golden elixir elder!"
"Hahaha! This is a great blessing! The golden elixir can be achieved within a hundred years, and it will be a dazzling existence in the entire Southern Wilderness Region."
"Although Qinghan herself is in line with the "Tai Xuan Jing" technique, it is also inseparable from her efforts!"
"Yeah..."
A few days later, Liu Qinghan sent away the last congratulatory elder and recruited his apprentice Liuli.
"Disciple, has Lin Xun reached the rear of the sect now?" Liu Qinghan asked.
Liuli nodded obediently, "Yes, Master, everything for Uncle Lin has been arranged."
"Yes!" Liu Qinghan nodded slightly and continued to ask, "Can I give you the second-level longevity pill?"
Liuli glanced at the storage ring. A crystal clear elixir was placed in the jade box. It was the second-level longevity elixir. Next to it was a dark golden wooden sign with the word "Qinghan" engraved on it.
"I gave it according to Master's instructions!"
"Then please step back. As a teacher, we need to consolidate one or two things."
"Yes!" Liuli bent down and took a few steps back, then left quickly.
Liu Qinghan stared ahead for a long time and muttered to himself.
"It's coming soon, Tianlan Secret Realm will be opened in five years!"
...
Three days later, Lin Xun had figured out the general situation here.
Qingyunshanfang City belongs to the Li Immortal Clan and has a large territory. It not only has the city, but also the specialty first-level spiritual material - Qingyun Bamboo.
Qingyun bamboo is green in color, tough and light, and can be used to make bamboo swords and shields.
Lin Xun was able to use talisman paper made from bamboo tanned inner membrane, which could draw low-grade talismans.
Therefore, the number of low-grade Talisman masters in the entire Qingyun Shanfang City is the largest.
In the surrounding neighbors, there is a couple who are casual cultivators. In the early stages of Qi refining, they go out early and come home late to work in the market.
There is a family who is a spiritual farmer who raises bamboo.
There are also a few households that have not seen anyone for several days, and they are practicing in the middle of the Qi refining period when they are out hunting monsters and looking for grass.
Overall, Ju Buyi is great!
The rent here alone costs five low-grade spiritual stones per month.
The spiritual stone in Lin Xun's hand was almost bottomed out, but most of it was spent on the array disk in his hand.
"Thanks to Shopkeeper Su, twenty low-grade spiritual stones were enough to win this formation."
After saying that, he raised his hand to input spiritual power into the battle plate. In an instant, a golden shield of light appeared, and then slowly expanded until it enveloped the entire room.
He felt for himself that the entire five-foot radius was covered by the formation.
"This formation has the effects of sound insulation, spirit isolation, and early warning. Although it has no attack power, it is what I need most! I can finally absorb the spiritual milk!"
Lin Xun felt quite sad.
Before the formation, he couldn't even practice dual cultivation with Yang Yun.
Just because the spiritual milk formed can only be looked at and not refined at all.
After all, this is a shantytown, a mixed bag of good and bad.
If the absorbed spiritual energy fluctuates and is discovered to be abnormal, then he is really not far from death.
Lin Xun took out a few more fireball charms and pasted them on the window before meditating and looking inside.
A precious tree swayed gently in the sea of ​​consciousness, with several drops of spiritual milk hanging on its branches.
The most eye-catching thing is that the color of this branch is actually a faint purple.
"Since Yun'er's father and brother were rescued last time, Zhiya has changed a lot and turned into lavender. I wonder if the effect of this spiritual milk has been improved?"
Lin Xun looked around for a long time and then said curiously.
